Prayer: This Writ petition has been filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying to issue a Writ of Mandamus to direc second and third respondents to give adequate police protection for restoration of compound wall in the petitioner's land at Survey No. 522/2, 522/2A, 522/3B and 542 at Kovalam Panchayat, Kanyakumari District by considering the respresentation dated 18.02.2023. For Petitioner : Mr.Isaac Mohanlal, Senior Advocate for M/s.Isaac Chambers For Respondents : Mr.A.K.Sriram, Senior Advocate, for M/s.S.Ramakrishnan, for R.4 to R.8 an R.10 : Mr.S.R.Raghunathan, for M/s.S.Saravanakumar for R. texts.facts: The Trust was established with the noble object of serving the marginalized population and to extend helping hand to vulnerable children women, senior citizens, children with special needs, terminally sick, people with mental issues and rehabilitation of leprosy people, HIV affected, disabled and Cancer patients, etc., The petitioner Trust has established various institutions to achieve the objectives of the Trust. The Trust has established rehabilitation centre namely, Stella Maris Leposy and Differently Abled Rehabilitation Centre, at Stella Maris Campus, Sarvodaya Nagar, Kanyakumari District (hereinafter called as the rehabilitation Centre) in the year 1997. It is a non profiteering, non-Governmental, Charitable Institution managed and administered by the Trust. Petitioners have rejected the demand of the Pandian and Alagesan stating that the land covered by the rehabilitation centre is a Patta land and meant for the exclusive use of the poor people of rehabilitation centre and in case, if it is made as public pathway, it will affect the rights of poor people in the rehabilitation centre. 7. On 12.02.2023, at about 11 A.M., Pandian and Alagesan with their henchman, forcefully entered into the rehabilitation centre and demolished the eastern compound wall of the rehabilitation centre and unearthed the gate in the entrance by beating the residents of the centre ____________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis who tried to prevent them and in the said incident one Mukesh was severely injured. The petitioner has submitted a representation to the second and third respondents to provide adequate police protection enabling them to restore the compound wall for safety and the interest of poor people. However on 28.05.2023, the agents of private respondents have trespassed into the lands of rehabilitation centre and parked the JCB. 13. On 04.06.2023 at 07.00 P.M., Pandian trespassed into the lands of the rehabilitation centre in his vehicle and threatened the people residing in the rehabilitation centre.
texts.arguments: 14. Learned counsel for the eleventh respondent has submitted that as per Section 131 of the Tamil Nadu Panchayat Act, 1994 no person shall build any wall, erect any fence, make any encroachment in or over any public road or any property vested to Village Panchayat.
